name: Flexibility
description: Splits, backbends and leg hangs that open your legs, back, hips and shoulders.

name: Strength
description: Holds, inverts and lifts that build strength in your arms, core and legs.

name: Spins on static pole
description: Spins on a fixed pole: you create the momentum and hold each shape for at least 360°.

name: Spins on spinning pole
description: Spins on a pole that turns with you. Hold each shape for at least 720° of rotation.
